choices.topic: How to print the control curve's EC50 limit?
choices.opus: Run 1: top tested dose, '>10000 nM'. Run 2: '>1804 nM'. Run 3: '>2537 nM' (fitted value).
choices.authors: Printed '>10000 nM' (footnote b), though their own fit gives about 2,500 nM.
choices.matters: Opus runs 2 and 3: 2 cells (potency limit and EC50 limit). Run 1 and Sonnet matched.

choices.topic: Sign printed for the fixed slope of 1?
choices.opus: Run 1: +1. Run 2: -1. Run 3: fitted -1 but printed +1.
choices.authors: Fitted +1 in their software, then printed -1.
choices.matters: Opus runs 1 and 3: 1 cell (0.50 microgram cAMP slope), graded E. Run 2 and Sonnet matched.

choices.topic: Which values go into the significance test?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: ANOVA with Tukey from the summary values (fitted value, error, number of experiments).
choices.sonnet: ANOVA with Tukey on per-experiment fitted values; all stars left empty.

choices.topic: Slope reported for the control arrestin curve?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: reported the pooled 4-parameter slope estimate, which is poorly determined.

choices.topic: Fit one pooled curve or one per experiment?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: one curve per condition on pooled points; per-experiment fits were unstable.
choices.sonnet: One curve per group on pooled points; rejected per-experiment fits.

choices.topic: Which experiments count for the 4 to 8 range?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: used all 8 columns for the 0.00 control and 4 for others.
choices.sonnet: Used every column present (8 for controls, 4 otherwise).

choices.opus: All 3 runs: excluded nothing more; assumed the deposit already omits it.
choices.sonnet: No exclusion applied; the excluded replicates cannot be identified.

choices.topic: Normalise the data again by the minimum response?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: no; the data are already in fold, so used as deposited.
choices.sonnet: No re-normalisation; used data as given.

choices.topic: What is Emax for the inhibition curve?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: the fitted lower plateau (fold left at maximal inhibition), not the span.
choices.sonnet: Lower plateau for cAMP, upper plateau for arrestin.

choices.topic: What does the plus-minus value stand for?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: standard error of the pooled curve-fit parameter; SEM across experiments for observed Emax.
choices.sonnet: Standard error of the pooled curve-fit parameters, not SEM across experiments.

choices.topic: When is the slope fixed at 1?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: only for the 0.50 microgram cAMP curve, as the footnote says.
choices.sonnet: Only the 0.50 microgram cAMP curve; others use the free 4-parameter fit.
choices.authors: Fixed on the 0.50 microgram cAMP curve (footnote a).

choices.topic: What is 'observed' Emax for the control arrestin curve?
choices.opus: All 3 runs: mean and SEM of the responses at the highest dose (10 micromolar), 16.54.
choices.sonnet: Mean and SEM across experiments of the response at the highest dose.
